title: Replace 'HMIS is not foundational' with a contextual classification test
requirements:
- Remove the categorical statement and give a functional test for when a shared HMIS/RHIS platform is foundational
- Clarify HMIS versus RHIS terminology and which HMIS capabilities qualify as DPI-H versus programme tools
- Consider a cross-cutting public-health information and analytics capability, including in the REDDHI minimum where installed
